sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that from one recovery, he has been falsely implicated in two separate crime.

In the first crime No. i.e. 88 of 2024, the applicant has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 09.09.2024 passed in criminal misc. bail application No. 9568 of 2024 and the second is the present one.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that from the possession of the applicant two mobile phones, two cheque books and one ATM as well as Rs. 170/- cash has been shown to be recovered.
The applicant is not named in the FIR.
There is no independent witness of the recovery.
The recovered mobile and Rs. 170/- cash belongs to the applicant.
The offence is triable by magistrate.

Except the confessional statement of the applicant and the co-accused, there is no other material to Yashpal Diwakar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158391664/
1 link the applicant with this crime.

entities.text: Yashpal Diwakar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is languishing in jail since 28.06.2024.
The applicant is not the previous convict.
It is further submitted that there is no possibility of the applicant of fleeing away after being released from jail or tampering with the witnesses.
In case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid facts as argued by the learned counsel for the applicant.

On due consideration to the fact that the offence is triable by magistrate; except the confessional statement of the applicant and the co-accused, there is nothing on record against the applicant; the applicant is not the previous convict, coupled with the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 28.06.2024 and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I find it to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Yashpal Diwakar, involved in Case Crime/FIR No. 89/2024, under Sections 419/420/467/468/471/120B IPC and Section 66D of the I.T. (Amendment) Act, 2008, Police Station - Cyber Crime, District - Lucknow, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
(iii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

(v) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
